column1: # comment: "Cognition alignments \u2014 the knowledge spectrum and its reified tier. schema.org offers a single flat knowsAbout; GMEOW's four-level spectrum down-collapses to it (lossy), and a bare schema:knowsAbout lifts to the eponymous gmeow:knowsAbout level (its honest floor \u2014 depth is never inferred from a flat edge). The reified gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency reads its depth on a gmeow:ProficiencyScale: the native gmeow:scaleKnowledgeDepth (the four gmeow:KnowledgeLevel ordinals) is the default, while Bloom's revised taxonomy (gmeow:scaleBloomRevised), SOLO (gmeow:scaleSOLO), and Dreyfus (gmeow:scaleDreyfus, languages) are reusable alternates \u2014 NO canonical framework is enforced (Principle 6). The cross-framework band correspondence is the documented alignment ledger in docs.md, never an OWL axiom (cognition \u22a5 expertise; the knows-axis and the can-do axis are never silently bridged, Principle 9)."

column6: schema:knowsAbout — an agent's knowledge of a subject — is exactly the gmeow:knowsAbout level of the four-level knowledge spectrum; the finer levels (understands, hasMastered) are GMEOW enrichment that down-collapses to this flat target.
